scope: Independent visual E/W run draft review; no candidate/selection modification
method: Actually inspected both current full 16-frame 256 contact sheets.
Actually inspected four native1254 drafts and old targets plus immediate neighboring1024 images.
Actually inspected E11/E12/E13 and W12 at1024 for doubtful transitions; all other arms and legs additionally inspected in larger review crops.
Current32 and native4 file SHA/dimensions/alpha are freshly read.
Subsequently actually inspected W07-v3 full native1254 against earlierW06/W08 andv2; freshly computed SHA.

supportObservation.E: Expected right support01–08 then left09–16; visible shoe long axes follow side travel plane.
supportObservation.W: Expected left support01–08 then right09–16; visible shoe long axes follow side travel plane.

drafts.observations: 近侧解剖右肩→右袖→弯肘→剑腕完整；远侧左手持符。剑刃改为近直立，改善02后摆→04前摆之间角度。腿脚、头部及支撑靴注册与旧03一致，未见外扭或支撑退化。
drafts.canvasRegistration: Normalized whole-canvas comparison; no crop/recenter/flip apparent. Small redraw variation exists; not a pixel-preservation claim.

drafts.observations: 近侧解剖左肩→左袖→胸前符手完整；远侧右手持剑。近直立剑刃改善02右上→04左上的角度过渡。剑腕02→03前移仍较大，但这是旧帧已有位移；本次没有新增手臂身份或腿脚错误。
drafts.canvasRegistration: Normalized whole-canvas comparison; no crop/recenter/flip apparent. Small redraw variation exists; not a pixel-preservation claim.

drafts.observations: 近侧解剖左肩章直接接蓝上臂及胸腰白袖口，最终连接到剑手；前方符手改接远侧袖。相较W06、旧W07、W08出现右剑左符身份交换。不得提升。
drafts.canvasRegistration: Normalized whole-canvas comparison; no crop/recenter/flip apparent. Small redraw variation exists; not a pixel-preservation claim.

drafts.observations: 近侧左肩→前方左符链恢复，远侧右剑臂分离正确；腿脚和注册未退化。剑腕归一1024约x580，旧W07约605，仅收回约25px；相对腰部仍在后伸端，W06约x340到W08约x655之间的主要位移仍集中在06→07。剑刃中间角度已改善，但不足以宣称剑腕中间摆位完成。
drafts.canvasRegistration: Normalized whole-canvas comparison; no crop/recenter/flip apparent. Small redraw variation exists; not a pixel-preservation claim.

drafts.observations: 实际原生图已复核：近侧解剖左肩章→蓝袖→前方蓝符手连续保留；远侧右袖从腰后伸出接剑手，身份正确。右剑腕已收到native约535,760的腰侧中间位置，较v2明显改善W06→W08的握持位移分配。剑刃斜向右上；未见穿袖或腿脚退化。
drafts.canvasRegistration: Whole-canvas visual registration maintained; slight redraw variation, not pixel identity.

limitations: Static image review does not establish final 1x temporal playback smoothness or a world-space foot lock.
The blade-angle revision in W03 does not remove the pre-existing large02→03 wrist translation; no claim that every arm velocity is uniform.
Normal perspective, airborne sole visibility, bent-knee recovery, and transient toe clearance were not treated as outward foot twist.
Native-generation provenance pixel checks are a separate root audit; this report records actual draft file hashes but does not substitute for that audit.
